description: This is a PHP class file for the SpotsController, which manages various data retrieval and caching functionalities for different modules in a SuiteCRM or SugarCRM-based project. It includes methods to generate, cache, and serve data related to accounts, leads, sales, services, activities, marketing, quotes, and related entities, primarily used for dashboard or reporting purposes.

classes.name: SpotsController
classes.description: Main controller class for handling data retrieval, caching, and serving for multiple modules such as Accounts, Leads, Sales, Services, Activities, Marketing, and Quotes within the SuiteCRM platform.

methods.name: getDatabaseType
methods.description: Returns the type of database in use (mysql, mssql, or undefined).

methods.description: Constructs access control SQL WHERE clause for a given module and alias.
